en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Jameel Bin Darraj who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘In what is between mysaww Pulpit and mysaww houses, there is a Garden from the Gardens of the Paradise, and mysaww Pulpit is upon a channel from the channels of the Paradise, and a Salaat (performed) in mysaww Masjid equates to a thousand Salaats (performed) in what is besides from the Masjids, except for the ‘الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ’ Sacred Masjid’.
Jameel said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The houses of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and the house of Ali<sup>asws</sup> are from it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, and superior (to it)’.
en.sarwar: 10. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “Between my pulpit and my houses is a garden of the gardens of paradise and my pulpit is a passageway of the passageways of paradise. Performing one salat (prayer) in my Masjid is equal to one thousand salat (prayer) in other Masjids except Masjid al-Haram (the Sacred Masjid).’
Jamil has said, ‘I then asked, is the house of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, of the houses of the Holy Prophet?’
He (the Imam) replied, ‘Yes, it is. In fact it is the best of them.’”
